ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity off-white/beige central surface area against 30% low-intensity black/dark-grey peripheral borders and focal spotting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense black pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edge and both distal tips. The right lobe features a distinct linear vertical column of dark circular spots. The left lobe exhibits more irregular, dispersed dark mottling and significant brownish-yellow staining in the mid-section.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression; estimated internal angle of 50 degrees; base of notch obscured by water splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible trailing edge. Peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the left lobe with pixel amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels relative to the mean edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges tapering to sharp, acute-angled distal tips; leading edges show a slight concave sweep toward the submerged peduncle.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized on both the left and right distal tips. Scattered white punctate marks are visible on the black peripheral borders.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-contrast linear marks (rake-like disruptions) detected on the inner high-intensity region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both distal tips resulting in irregular structural protrusions and high-contrast white-on-black pixel mapping.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brownish-yellow pixel staining (diatom accumulation) covering the central and lower-left regions of the high-intensity ventral surface.
